title: ShieldCare Instalments: the Loading for Claims Already Met
content:
## The loading

An instalment on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan carries a loading where the plan has already
cost the retailer money in claims. Two things are read from the plan's own history: the payouts booked
on it inside the last 12 months, and the claims filed on it in that time.

| What the plan's history shows | The loading for the claims already met |
| --- | --- |
| the payouts booked on the plan inside the last 12 months come to more than 2500.00, and 2 or more claims stand filed on it in that time | 15 percent |
| those payouts come to more than 1000.00 but no more than 2500.00, and at least 1 claim stands filed in that time | 8 percent |
| every other plan | no loading for the claims already met is added to it |

## Both sides of the two bands

Payouts of exactly 2500.00 are not more than 2500.00, so they fall to the middle band, where being
more than 1000.00 they carry 8 percent provided at least 1 claim stands filed inside the year. Payouts
of 2500.01 are above the upper threshold, and then carry 15 percent only where 2 or more claims stand
filed inside the year; with a single claim filed, the upper row is not reached. Payouts of exactly
1000.00 are not more than 1000.00 and carry no loading at all.

## Cases on hypothetical records

| Payouts in the last 12 months | Claims filed in that time | Loading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 900.00 | 4 | none |
| 2900.00 | 1 | none |
| 1400.00 | 1 | 8 percent |
| 2500.00 | 2 | 8 percent |
| 2900.00 | 3 | 15 percent |
